Ting Loop

Loop it until you can say it.

A free listening and reading trainer in your browser. Tap a sentence to hear it, loop it until you can say it, then practise its words. Your progress stays on your device.

Courses

Spiralio New

Same situations, richer language each time. Spiralio covers 90 everyday topics and takes you through them three times: at A1, A2 and B1. Each round has 90 lessons in three sets of 30, with 7 conversational sentences per lesson. Every time you return, the vocabulary is richer, the dialogue more natural and the grammar more advanced, building confidence and fluency step by step.

Chinese English French German Indonesian Italian Japanese Spanish Ukrainian

Many more languages will follow.

What you can do

Listen & loop
Tap a sentence and it repeats until you stop it. Autoplay moves through the lesson on its own, 1–3 times per sentence, with its translation if you like. Speed, pause and a gradual speed-up are adjustable.
Read
Sentence cards with transcription and a translation in the language you choose, or Reading Mode for the whole lesson as a compact list. Highlight words, tag sentences 1, 2, 3, filter and search.
Words & grammar
Each lesson's word list with its own player; mark difficult words with ★. Grammar notes explain the sentences. (In courses that include them.)
Train
A vocabulary trainer that brings words back just before you forget them. My words shows how each one is doing; Bubbles and Listen add playful practice.
Speak
Record yourself and hear your voice alternate with the original.
Make your own
My Loop Lab: paste your own sentences, words and notes, and share them as a file.
Practical
Dark mode, a compact view, a pocket lock for listening on the go, backup and restore, and keyboard shortcuts on a computer (listed in Settings).

Notes

🎓 Vocabulary trainer
A good order
  1. Words | Sentences — two kinds of items, each with its own Track 1 and Track 2.
  2. Choose lessons — the words (or sentences) you want to learn. Add lessons as you move on.
  3. Review — the words that are due today. Do these first.
  4. New words — learn and test words you have not trained yet.
  5. Bubbles — a game with words at level 0 or that went wrong. Practice only.
  6. My words — every word with its level and views. Check the ones you see very often.
Due shows when your words come back, and lets you shift or spread the dates.
Track 1 / Track 2 are two completely separate sets: levels, due dates, lessons, streak, Bubbles and My words. Use them, for example, for word → translation in one and translation → word in the other. Only the ★ marks are shared.

📅 Due
How Due works
Every word you have trained comes back for review on a certain day. By day lists those days (days already past included), Next weeks shows what is coming.
Shift moves every due date by the number of days you enter. It matters most when you have missed a day or two — or worse, whole weeks because of a holiday, work overload or illness. Without it, all your words fall overdue at once and you come back to a mountain. Shift forward by the days you missed: everything moves later by the same amount, nothing is lost, the gaps between your words stay as they were, and you restart with a normal day. The longer the break, the more you need it. The box suggests the days since your last session; a negative number moves the dates earlier.
Spread takes the words that are due now (or overdue), the most overdue first, and deals them out over the next N days: with 3, about a third are due today, a third tomorrow, a third the day after. Use it when the pile is still too big to do in one day.
After a long break: Shift first, then Spread if there are still too many. Undo takes back the last Shift or Spread. Shift and Spread are part of Premium.

Navigation & Tools — occasional

EscClose the word list, cancel recording, close Reading Mode, or close this menu
VOpen search
Hold APocket lock: starts Autoplay (or, in the word list, the word player) and locks the screen; slide to unlock
Hold 1/2/3On a filter button: remove that category from every card (Hold All: all categories, asks twice)
Hold ⛶The corner button under Next: drag Last/Next up or down
KVocabulary trainer (inside: Space shows the answer, F = I knew, D = Again, Esc = Exit; 🎧 Listening: R = hear again)
WIn the word list: 📊 My words (inside: W changes the order, ←/→ flip the cards, Esc closes)
BIn 📊 My words or the trainer's home: 🫧 Bubbles (inside: S shuffles, Esc exits; in a bubble's card F = I knew, D = Again, X = exit)
EIn 📊 My words: 🎧 Listen (inside: Space = Show / Next, R = hear again, A = Auto, Esc closes)
4Word list of the current lesson (↑/↓ other lessons, A plays the words, S sets plays per word, 4 or Esc closes)
GInside the word list: grammar notes of the same lesson (4 goes back, Esc closes)
BOpen/close this menu
ZCard view: hide all controls except course, ☰ and PN+EN (Z again: all back)

Left-hand keys only, by design — works the same on QWERTY and QWERTZ keyboards.

Danger Zone

Applies only to the currently open lesson pack. Cannot be undone.

Resets the total play time counter shown in Reading Mode. Applies across all packs, not just the current one. Cannot be undone.

Deletes all highlights, assignments, counters, and settings for the currently open course only. Other courses are not affected. Cannot be undone.

Deletes ALL highlights, assignments, counters, and settings across EVERY course, plus the access-code unlock — you'll need to re-enter the access code next time. This is a full factory reset and cannot be undone.
